topic: Finding a lost wallet on the subway
passage: Last Wednesday, I found a wallet on the subway. I was sitting near the door when a man jumped off at the last second and dropped it on the floor. I picked it up and called out, but the doors had already closed. I opened the wallet and looked inside. There was a bus card, some cash, and an old photo of a little girl. I wanted to return it, so I got off at the next station and walked up to the service desk. A kind officer wrote down my name, phoned the owner, and explained what happened. Twenty minutes later, the man rushed in and thanked me again and again. He had searched his bag three times and almost cried. I handed over the wallet with a smile. Then he pulled out a small box of tea and held it out. I turned it down at first, but he insisted and pushed the tea into my hand. I walked out of the station and felt happy all day, even though I arrived late for work.

The kind officer phoned the owner right away.
I walked out of the station and felt happy.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录，主弱项继续是过去式 -ed 听辨和短语动词连读，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「在地铁上捡到钱包」是全新的日常/出行话题，短文里有 jumped/dropped/picked/closed/opened/looked/wanted/walked/phoned/explained/rushed/thanked/searched/handed/pulled/insisted/arrived 等规则过去式；jumped off、picked up、called out、got off、walked up、wrote down、handed over、pulled out、held out、turned down 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
